reviews.title: Fuente de alimentación Lian Li
reviews.comment: Técnicamente la fuente rinde lo que dice, el problema es que me llegó con la rejilla que cubre el cooler deformada por presión o golpe en su traslado por parte del correo y que los cables no son totalmente blancos, hice el reclamo a la garantía y me contestaron que no sale el color en las fotos enviadas, el tema de garantía es dudoso.
reviews.author: Andres

reviews.title: Sharp Coil Whine and Noise at moderate-high load
reviews.comment:
Noisy with loud coil whine at higher loads (gaming or gpu intensive tasks like AI). I went with 1200w to have enough power for RTX 5090 founder and AMD 9800x3d, and an Asus B850 motherboard - but moderate to high load makes the unit struggle with higher fan speed and high pitch coil whine.
Very disappointing to see a newer Lian Li product come with issues!
reviews.author: GadgeTron

reviews.title: Great PSU for 5090
reviews.comment:
Solid PSU, my main comparison is the 1300 Lian Li Edge series.
The native 600 watt 12VHPWR cable here was an improvement over the Lian Li edge, fit snugly into my 5090 but wasn’t impossible to pull back out either. Braided cables are nice but wish they had the Velcro cable ties as well, were not included like in Lian Li edge series.
